title: Track A Week Of Meals From 1 Photo
hook: You can track a whole week of meal prep without logging every ingredient by hand.
body: Tap Meal Prep, add photos of your batch, snap the olive oil, then tell the AI how many salads, how many eggs and how much chicken got eaten. Mine came back at 683 calories per salad, against about 720 when I tracked it by hand.
close: Save this for your next meal prep day.
youtube_description:
You can track a whole week of meal prep without logging every ingredient by hand.

Try your free Abs By AI preview: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=daily-salad&utm_content=sl03-short5

Tap Meal Prep, add photos of your batch, snap the olive oil, then tell the AI how many salads, how many eggs and how much chicken got eaten. Mine came back at 683 calories per salad, against about 720 when I tracked it by hand.

Full video on my channel: How I Make My Daily Salad: 700 Calories, $4 a Bowl, Fresh for 7 Days
